verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own marketing pages say share awards can be granted in bulk as well as one by one, and that granting workflows can be automated in bulk; it also claims historical transaction data can be brought into the cap table. Evidence is limited to marketing copy, with no detail on how the bulk upload works. Missing for 10: documentation of the bulk upload mechanism (file template, validation, error handling), explicit confirmation that historical transactions can be imported in batches, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time

citations.quote: Grant share awards one by one, or in bulk, creating, signing and sharing contracts in just a few clicks.
Automate your granting, document and signature workflows in bulk to make expansion easy.
Bring historical transaction data into your cap table, with documents attached for maximum visibility and accuracy.
